## Checklist

- [ ] `gofmt -l .` prints nothing
- [ ] Passed `go vet ./...` and `staticcheck ./...`

- [ ] No new third-party dependency, or one agreed on in an issue first

- [ ] Relevant documentation updated (if necessary)
